comparison.objective: Spike an IV bag and prime its drip chamber to a target liquid level; the candidate sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Aseptic cap removal, axial spike insertion, chamber positioning, and controlled squeezing versus coaxial driver/wrench counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Spike is seated and liquid length is 15–27 mm without contamination or overfill; candidate requires retained angular calibration through three cycles.
comparison.reason: Fluid-level priming and sterile insertion do not test preservation of a screw setting against locking torque.
